#layer2
```{r}
# layer2: time-point number benchmark gene-level parameter inference

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"

obj_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "sim_objects")
phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
param_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_param")
param_long_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "param_long")
param_wide_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "param_wide")
index_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "index")

dir.create(param_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(param_long_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(param_wide_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(index_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

timepoint_vec <- c(24, 12, 8, 6, 4, 2)
n_repeat <- 1
B_use <- 10
n_worker_use <- 1
force_rerun_param <- TRUE

expected_zt_list <- list(
  "24" = seq(0, 23, by = 1),
  "12" = seq(0, 22, by = 2),
  "8"  = seq(0, 21, by = 3),
  "6"  = seq(0, 20, by = 4),
  "4"  = seq(0, 18, by = 6),
  "2"  = c(4, 12)
)

if (force_rerun_param) {
  unlink(param_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  unlink(param_long_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  unlink(param_wide_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  dir.create(param_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(param_long_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(param_wide_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Step 1. Run layer2

param_record_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (n_timepoint in timepoint_vec) {
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("============================================================")
    message("Running layer2 | n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint, " | repeat = ", rep_id)

    obj_file <- file.path(
      obj_dir,
      paste0("simulate_data_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.rds")
    )

    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    param_file <- file.path(
      param_dir,
      paste0("res_param_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    param_long_csv <- file.path(
      param_long_dir,
      paste0("param_long_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".csv")
    )

    param_long_rds <- file.path(
      param_long_dir,
      paste0("param_long_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    param_wide_csv <- file.path(
      param_wide_dir,
      paste0("param_wide_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".csv")
    )

    param_wide_rds <- file.path(
      param_wide_dir,
      paste0("param_wide_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    run_status <- "finished_new"
    run_error <- NA_character_

    tryCatch({
      stopifnot(file.exists(obj_file))
      stopifnot(file.exists(phase_file))

      obj_sim <- readRDS(obj_file)
      DefaultAssay(obj_sim) <- "RNA"

      count <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
        obj_sim,
        assay = "RNA",
        slot = "counts"
      )

      metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
        as.data.frame()
      metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

      res_phase <- readRDS(phase_file) %>%
        mutate(cell = as.character(cell))

      metadata <- metadata %>%
        mutate(cell = as.character(cell))

      res_phase <- res_phase[match(metadata$cell, res_phase$cell), , drop = FALSE]

      stopifnot(
        nrow(count) == 4000,
        ncol(count) == 20000,
        identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell),
        identical(res_phase$cell, metadata$cell),
        all(c("cell", "theta_pred", "r_cell", "Rbar") %in% colnames(res_phase)),
        all(c("ZT_sym", "ZT_true", "condition", "group", "celltype") %in% colnames(metadata)),
        all(is.finite(res_phase$theta_pred)),
        all(is.finite(res_phase$r_cell)),
        length(unique(metadata$celltype)) == 1,
        all(unique(metadata$celltype) == "Celltype1"),
        length(unique(metadata$condition)) == 2,
        all(sort(unique(metadata$condition)) == c("cond_1", "cond_2"))
      )

      zt_observed <- sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)))
      zt_expected <- expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]]

      message("Object dimension:")
      print(dim(count))

      message("Condition table:")
      print(table(metadata$condition))

      message("Celltype table:")
      print(table(metadata$celltype))

      message("Observed ZT: ", paste(zt_observed, collapse = ", "))
      message("Expected ZT: ", paste(zt_expected, collapse = ", "))

      message("Median r_cell: ", round(median(res_phase$r_cell, na.rm = TRUE), 4))
      message("Median Rbar: ", round(median(res_phase$Rbar, na.rm = TRUE), 4))

      stopifnot(identical(zt_observed, zt_expected))

      res_param <- infer_gene_param(
        count = count,
        metadata = metadata,
        theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred,
        r_cell = res_phase$r_cell,
        strata_by = "condition",
        B = B_use,
        n_worker = n_worker_use,
        setseed = 2026 + rep_id,
        Verbose = TRUE
      )

      res_param$benchmark <- list(
        benchmark = "timepoint_number",
        n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
        repeat_id = rep_id,
        ZT_points = zt_expected,
        strata_by = "condition",
        B = B_use,
        n_worker = n_worker_use,
        gene_number = 4000,
        cell_number = 20000,
        n_condition = 2,
        n_celltype = 1
      )

      res_param$param_long <- res_param$param_long %>%
        mutate(
          n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
          repeat_id = rep_id,
          benchmark = "timepoint_number"
        )

      res_param$param_wide <- res_param$param_wide %>%
        mutate(
          n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
          repeat_id = rep_id,
          benchmark = "timepoint_number"
        )

      if (!is.null(res_param$bootstrap_res)) {
        res_param$bootstrap_res <- res_param$bootstrap_res %>%
          mutate(
            n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
            repeat_id = rep_id,
            benchmark = "timepoint_number"
          )
      }

      saveRDS(res_param, param_file)

      write_csv(res_param$param_long, param_long_csv)
      saveRDS(res_param$param_long, param_long_rds)

      write_csv(res_param$param_wide, param_wide_csv)
      saveRDS(res_param$param_wide, param_wide_rds)

      message("Saved layer2 result: ", param_file)

      param_record_all[[run_id]] <- tibble(
        n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
        repeat_id = rep_id,
        ZT_points = paste(zt_expected, collapse = ","),
        object_file = obj_file,
        res_phase_file = phase_file,
        res_param_file = param_file,
        param_long_csv = param_long_csv,
        param_long_rds = param_long_rds,
        param_wide_csv = param_wide_csv,
        param_wide_rds = param_wide_rds,
        object_exists = file.exists(obj_file),
        phase_exists = file.exists(phase_file),
        param_exists = file.exists(param_file),
        strata_by = "condition",
        B = B_use,
        n_worker = n_worker_use,
        status = run_status,
        error_message = run_error
      )

      write_csv(
        bind_rows(param_record_all),
        file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_res_param_file_index.csv")
      )

      rm(obj_sim, count, metadata, res_phase, res_param)
      gc()

    }, error = function(e) {
      run_status <<- "failed"
      run_error <<- conditionMessage(e)

      message("FAILED layer2 | n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint, " | repeat = ", rep_id)
      message("Error: ", run_error)

      param_record_all[[run_id]] <<- tibble(
        n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
        repeat_id = rep_id,
        ZT_points = paste(expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]], collapse = ","),
        object_file = obj_file,
        res_phase_file = phase_file,
        res_param_file = param_file,
        param_long_csv = param_long_csv,
        param_long_rds = param_long_rds,
        param_wide_csv = param_wide_csv,
        param_wide_rds = param_wide_rds,
        object_exists = file.exists(obj_file),
        phase_exists = file.exists(phase_file),
        param_exists = file.exists(param_file),
        strata_by = "condition",
        B = B_use,
        n_worker = n_worker_use,
        status = run_status,
        error_message = run_error
      )

      write_csv(
        bind_rows(param_record_all),
        file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_res_param_file_index.csv")
      )

      gc()
    })

    run_id <- run_id + 1
  }
}

# Step 2. Save final index

param_index <- bind_rows(param_record_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_timepoint), repeat_id)

write_csv(
  param_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_res_param_file_index.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  param_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_res_param_file_index.rds")
)

print(param_index)

message("Finished time-point number layer2 benchmark.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
message("Layer2 results: ", param_dir)
```
